verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a terminal app for iOS, so keeping a session alive across network changes and device sleep is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack covers session persistence, mosh-style roaming, background execution or reconnect behavior. The items on per-window context, .profile and config persistence describe settings and startup customization, not keeping a live session running.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can keep my terminal session alive across network changes and device sleep
